title: 第5章  拦路初次战斗第6章  有六分故人之资
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
宿野的眼神也逐渐冷了下来。
“我挺反感有人叫我胖子的。”
“凌沧海，你要是想活动活动筋骨，我随时奉陪。”
“但你要明白，差班就是插班，把好苗子放在你的七班这种差班中，完全就是浪费了这颗好苗子。”
宿野直视着凌沧海的眼眸，颇有一种针尖对麦芒的感觉。
闻言，凌沧海刚准备要说些什么，就听到高跟鞋踩在地上的哒哒声在走廊中出现。
两人的目光顺着声音处看去，就见主任的身影出现在走廊的尽头。
“凌老师，你跟我来一下，院长有事找你。”
主任淡淡扫了一眼宿野，就将目光放在凌沧海的身上。
“好的主任，我这就来。”
凌沧海将眼镜从口袋中拿出来，戴在脸上，用警告的眼神看了一眼宿野，就迈步往主任的方向走去。
注视着凌沧海和主任离开的背影，宿野并没有再说话，但眼中的冷意，却没有任何的减少。
……
另一边。
有些昏暗的街道中。
夜离殇抱着云绒狐，将手中拿着的一个苹果递到云绒狐的嘴边，看着云绒狐咬了一口果肉，果肉将它的一侧脸颊撑得鼓鼓的可爱模样，夜离殇的嘴角不自觉地勾起一抹淡淡的笑意。
而就在此时，夜离殇发现洛星燃带着两个跟班从拐角处走出，挡在自己面前。
“洛星燃，你这是什么意思？”
看着挡在面前的三人，夜离殇的眉头微微一皱，眼中出现几分不悦。
“没什么意思。”

“我们都刚刚成为御兽师，不如来一场公平的一对三战斗，提前感受一下御兽师之间的战斗。”
洛星燃拿出口中的棒棒糖，用眼神示意了一下脚边的玄甲水犀。
得到洛星燃的示意，玄甲水犀往前走了两步，目光直视着前方的夜离殇。
跟在洛星燃背后的两个小跟班也在此时放出了自己的御兽，一条长着骨刺的黑犬，以及一只黑白相间的兔子。
“公平？”
“一对三？”
“洛星燃，你是怎么好意思说出这句话的。”
夜离殇抬眸看了一眼洛星燃，眼中的鄙视完全就没有掩饰。
但很快，夜离殇的目光就从洛星燃的身上，转到三只御兽的身上，玄甲水犀，骨刺犬，墨雪灵兔的战斗能力都不弱。
尤其是玄甲水犀，常态下是肯定强于她怀中抱着的云绒狐的。
“切，你可是拥有s级天赋的大天才，我们三个哪能跟你这位七班的天才相提并论呢。”
“一对一的话，那岂不是不给你这位七班天才的面子，也就只有一对三才公平喽。”
“毕竟，你可是s级的天才。”
洛星燃嘴角微勾，对于夜离殇投来的鄙视眼神完全不在意。
三打一，优势在她们这一边，无论夜离殇说什么，洛星燃现在都不会在意的。
有什么气，等会儿在战斗中发泄出去不就行了。
尤其是想到等会能看到夜离殇那不服气，但又不得不低头的模样，洛星燃的心中就莫名的感觉兴奋。
呜嘤～
云绒狐从夜离殇的怀中下来，叫唤一声后，就用小爪子推着夜离殇的小腿，似乎是让夜离殇先走一样。
“啧～”

“真是主仆情深呢，来让我们试试，s级天才的实力怎么样。”
content_en:
Suye's eyes gradually became colder.
"I'm disgusted when someone calls me fat."
"Ling Canghai, if you want to stretch your muscles, I will accompany you at any time."
"But you have to understand that a poor class is a transfer. Putting a good talent in a poor class like your seventh class is a complete waste of this good talent."
Suye looked directly into Ling Canghai's eyes, feeling like he was facing a needle.
Hearing this, Ling Canghai was just about to say something when he heard the click of high heels on the ground in the corridor.
The two of them looked along the sound and saw the director's figure appearing at the end of the corridor.
"Teacher Ling, come with me. The dean wants to see you for something."
The director glanced at Suye briefly, then focused on Ling Canghai.
"Okay director, I'll be here right away."
Ling Canghai took his glasses out of his pocket, put them on his face, glanced at Su Ye with a warning look, and walked towards the director.
Watching Ling Canghai and the director leaving, Suye said nothing, but the coldness in his eyes did not diminish in any way.
…
other side.
In some dark streets.
Yeli Shang hugged Yunrong Fox and handed an apple he was holding to Yunrong Fox's mouth. Watching Yunrong Fox take a bite of the pulp, which made one of its cheeks bulge in a cute way, Yeli Shang's lips unconsciously raised a faint smile.
At this moment, Ye Lishang discovered that Luo Xingran came out of the corner with two followers and stood in front of him.
"Luo Xingran, what do you mean?"
Looking at the three people standing in front of him, Ye Lishang frowned slightly, with a hint of displeasure in his eyes.
"It's not interesting."
"We have all just become beast masters, so why not have a fair one-on-three battle to experience the battle between beast masters in advance."
Luo Xingran took out the lollipop in his mouth and gestured with his eyes to the Black Armored Water Rhinoceros at his feet.
After receiving Luo Xingran's signal, Xuanjia Water Rhinoceros took two steps forward and looked directly at Ye Lishang in front of him.
The two little followers following Luo Xingran also released their own beasts at this time, a black dog with bone spurs and a black and white rabbit.
"Fair?"
"One to three?"
"Luo Xingran, how did you have the nerve to say this?"
Ye Lishang raised his eyes and glanced at Luo Xingran, the contempt in his eyes completely undisguised.
But soon, Ye Lishang's eyes turned from Luo Xingran to the three beasts. Black-armored water rhinoceros, bone-spurred dog, and Mo Xue Lingtu were all powerful in battle.
Especially the Black-armored Water Rhinoceros, which was definitely stronger than the Yunrong Fox in her arms under normal circumstances.
"Tch, you are a great genius with S-level talent. How can the three of us compare to you, a genius from Class 7?"
"If it's one-on-one, wouldn't it mean that you, the genius of Class 7, aren't given any face? It's only fair to do it one-on-three."
"After all, you are an S-level genius."
Luo Xingran's lips curled up slightly, not paying attention to Ye Lishang's contemptuous look.
Three against one, the advantage was on their side. No matter what Ye Lishang said, Luo Xingran wouldn't care now.
If you have any anger, just vent it out later in the battle.
Especially when he thought about seeing Ye Lishang's unconvinced but forced bowed look later, Luo Xingran felt inexplicably excited.
Woohoo~
Yunrong Hu came down from Ye Lizhang's arms. After calling out, he pushed Ye Lizhang's calf with his little paws, as if to let Ye Lizhang go first.
"Tsk~"
"There is such a deep love between master and servant. Let's try it out and see how strong an S-level genius is."
